headline: Key Context Management in tpl/template.go
what_breaks: tpl.Context — relies on contexthelpers and identity packages
tpl.Template — interface used for rendering templates
tpl.RenderingContext — used for site/language rendering context
why: This file is crucial for managing template rendering contexts and dependencies. Changes here can affect how templates interact with site data and rendering logic across many dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to the Context variable and its dispatchers
Ensure Template interface methods are correctly implemented
Check interactions with RenderingContext for site rendering logic
